description: This file defines the utility class 'PolicyEnforcers' which provides static methods to create various types of 'Enforcer' objects for policy evaluation, utilizing different underlying implementations optimized for throughput or memory.

classes.name: PolicyEnforcers
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods to instantiate different types of 'Enforcer' implementations based on policies.

methods.name: defaultEvaluator
methods.description: Returns a general purpose 'Enforcer' optimized for throughput, initialized with the provided policy.

methods.name: throughputOptimizedEvaluator
methods.description: Creates an 'Enforcer' optimized for throughput using a Trie-based implementation.

methods.name: memoryOptimizedEvaluator
methods.description: Creates an 'Enforcer' optimized for memory usage using a Tree-based implementation.
